collection_purpose: Reproduce Δt-aware LSTM anomaly detection experiments for session operations, aligning with SRS.md section 1.

pseudonymization.key_derivation: K_ds = HKDF(digest=SHA256, ikm=JWT_HMAC_KEY, salt="", info="sid", length=32)

known_biases: Synthetic sessions follow a fixed login→browse→edit→logout template with bounded randomization, under-representing failure paths.
Latency distribution is uniform between 45-480 ms and lacks heavy-tail behaviours seen in production.
IP addresses are allocated from documentation ranges and do not reflect geolocation diversity.
generation_command: docker compose up -d collector && npm --prefix collector run seed && python -m trainer.scripts.preprocess --config trainer/configs/default.yaml && python -m trainer.scripts.train --config trainer/configs/default.yaml && python -m trainer.scripts.score --config trainer/configs/default.yaml && python -m trainer.scripts.threshold --config trainer/configs/default.yaml && python -m trainer.scripts.explain --config trainer/configs/default.yaml
